text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I can't believe I lost again. Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I need you to give it to me
straight. How
was my performance
today?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Don't hold back—just let me have it.
Feelings will
only muddle my
calculations.

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer! Let's have a meeting
as soon
as we get back.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's a meticulous and time-consuming
process, but
strategizing for the sake of
victory is worth it!

Afterwards, Biwa Hayahide and I hunker
down to
discuss the race and what can
be done to improve
her performance.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What else should I focus on if not that?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There's clearly something wrong with the
way I'm
running my races now! Why else
would I have
failed this badly?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list: それは正しい現状理解じゃない
choice_data_list_en: That's not an accurate grasp of the situation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list: 良い点も悪い点も理解しよう
choice_data_list_en: Let's understand both the good and bad points.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'm the one who's letting my
feelings get in
the way.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. I need to go clear my head.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for being so blunt. I needed
to hear
that.

Biwa Hayahide goes off on a short run to
blow off
some steam. Later, she joins me
for a strategy
meeting feeling much
better.
